reviews.text: They've deleted my review. I recommend going somewhere else; their prices are outrageous. A year ago, I went to another vet for the same thing and they charged me a third of what this one charged.

Not recommended at all. All they care about is squeezing as much money out of you as possible. They wanted to admit my dog ​​for 24 hours and charge me €650, even though there was nothing that could be done for him. The visit was €115, and then they charged me again the next day to put him down, plus the cost of the euthanasia. They're truly disgusting with money.

I went for an emergency because my dog ​​ate chocolate. The staff were very friendly and everything was fine, but the price they charged me for a stomach pump was outrageous. A year ago, I had the same emergency and went to another place, and they charged me €80 for the same thing, while they charged €200. Clearly, I won't be going back. Find another emergency clinic with reasonable prices.

I'm giving it one star because there isn't a lower rating. They don't know what they're doing, and on top of that, it's super expensive!
I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

Thank you so much, Dolores, for your review 💙 We're so glad to hear your experience at SURvet was positive.

We're here for you! Best regards!

I brought my dog ​​Lyona in for an emergency bite to her ear. They were super fast, very professional and the dog is recovering very well. Thanks to all the staff, from the administrative to the doctor!:)
Very professional, fast and attentive

Very poor service, neither truthful nor efficient. My dog ​​was hit by a car, they gave him basic care and recommended this clinic. We called to see if they could perform emergency surgery, and they told us they could over the phone. The on-call orthopedic surgeon was very unprofessional and didn't do a proper assessment. On top of that, he wanted more days of hospitalization because they don't operate on weekends. We finally decided to take him out of that clinic and to another one. I would not recommend the veterinary care at this center at all.
Zero empathy and €115 for the visit to leave the same way I arrived.

Thank you so much, Andrei, for your 5-star rating ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ and for trusting us.

We're here for you 🐾💙! …
Thank you, Miguel, for your review! We're glad to hear that your experience at SURvet was positive.
Excellent care for the dog (Dallas) and excellent customer service

Thank you so much, Vanina, for your positive review ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We're delighted to hear that your experience at SURvet was positive. Please don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or concerns. Best regards! 🐾💙 …

Thank you so much, Roberto, for your positive review ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thank you for trusting our team, and we hope to serve you again when you need us! 🐾💙 …

Excellent, attentive, and quick in emergencies. The veterinarian is very kind and explains everything you need to know. I'm very happy with the care my kitten received. The team at the veterinary hospital is very friendly.

The consultation was for a cat, the treatment of the animal was excellent, and the veterinarians' explanations were very clear.

I was very happy. The cat has made a full recovery.

We are very grateful for the care received, your professionalism and affection.
Mini was admitted to the clinic in the emergency room and received all the necessary care. She was also followed up after discharge.
Now we see her and she is perfectly fine, it would seem like we dreamed it. If it weren't for the shaved head she still has, which reminds us that she was very ill, about to die...
Thank you, for saving her, for being her angels.
To the entire SurVet team, thank you, especially to Laia, Ignasi and Elena.
A big hug,
Mireia and Gisela
I took my kitten Dana to the vet, and Laia treated her with so much love. A 10 out of 10 for Laia, keep it up!!!! ❤️

Our experience at SURvet has been fantastic. The attentive care from the very beginning makes you feel more at ease. In addition to the good service, they found the root cause of what was happening to Yago. He recovered very well and is now feeling much better.
Thanks to the whole team!

The receptionist had absolutely no empathy. I called yesterday because I found a badly injured pigeon, it was dying, and I asked if they could please perform a humane euthanasia. He told me they didn't treat pigeons. I understand that much. But when you call someone crying, desperate, my voice breaking, and you don't have the capacity (or sensitivity) to even try to help me, not even by directing me to an exotic animal clinic, or giving me any information on how to help the animal… Veterinarians are supposed to have a compassionate heart, but in this case, I encountered one who completely lacked it. I would not recommend him at all.
Thank you so much, Farah, for your review and for trusting SURvet. 💙 We're delighted to hear that your experience with our team has been positive. We're here to help! …

ABUSE AND LACK OF ETHICS
One star seems like too much for a place like this.
It's one of the worst clinics I've ever been to. I took a stray cat there on the suggestion of a veterinarian for a check-up and dressing change. I BROUGHT THE BANDAGE. All they did was change it, and they just put a simple piece of cloth on it.

They charged me €107.
I repeat: €107 for putting on a dressing that I bought myself.
There was no anesthesia, no medication. It was 5 minutes. I think it's a total lack of respect for pet owners who only want the best for their animals. They take advantage of the situation and the love we have for them to charge exorbitant prices without justification. I absolutely do not recommend it. Find another place where they won't empty your wallet for something so basic. It's a disgrace.
Thank you so much, José, for your 5-star rating and for trusting our team. We're here to help if you have any questions or concerns. Best regards!

Thank you so much, José, for your 5-star review!

If you have any questions or would like to elaborate, we're happy to hear from you. Best regards! 🐾 …
Excellent care from the entire veterinary team during a difficult time for our cat. After a week in the hospital, she recovered. Thank you all, especially Itala and Ignasi.

Survet is a Center with a lot of experience, the first time, for surgery on my dog ​​with gastric obstruction, I was very satisfied. Now I have returned with a minor issue and I have felt the same, a lot of confidence. It is my reference veterinary hospital. I recommend it to everyone! Thanks to the whole team!!
I would never recommend them to anyone. They are very irresponsible and have terrible tempers.
They care about your pet's well-being; the center is highly equipped, and the staff is empathetic and attentive. I felt supported at all times while my pet was there.
He treats my dog ​​very well and quickly.

I recently took my dog ​​Bruno to the clinic because he had pancreatitis. He was very sick, and I was desperate because I had been to several emergency clinics before this one was recommended to me. I am so happy and grateful for everything they have done for him from the very beginning. The care and professionalism of everyone there is top-notch!

I am so grateful, and Bruno has also regained his natural joy.

Thank you 🫶🐶
